reviews.review_title: A SMALL DUNGEON FULL OF GREAT IDEAS!
reviews.review_description: Goofy Dungeon is a short but really charming VR adventure. Pixel art isn't usually my favorite visual style, but it works extremely well here and everything feels polished and smooth. I especially loved the humor and the amount of interaction: you can grab, break and experiment with so many things in the environment, while optional collectibles encourage you to explore every room. The puzzles are clever without being unnecessarily frustrating, and the sound design is excellent too. Around one hour for the main adventure feels absolutely fair at this price, especially if you take the time to search for everything. A lovely surprise from a French solo developer!

reviews.review_title: One of the best vr games
reviews.review_description: Goofy dungeons is really enjoyable game and its art style is nice, I can tell the dev who made this game put a lot of effort and especially for its low price it is a purchase worth getting
